outcome: Reasons for non-attendance at postnatal clinic
cohort: 400 nursing mothers attending child immunization clinics in Enugu, Nigeria for their babies' second dose of the Oral Polio Vaccine (OPV2) at 10 weeks postpartum
finding: Postnatal clinic attendance at 6 weeks postpartum was suboptimal (59%), with lack of awareness being the main reason for non-attendance.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was a significant predictor of postnatal clinic attendance, with vaginal delivery being associated with lower attendance.
